title: The Alibi of Greywater Bay Revisited
author: Rosalind Marchetti
blurb: Ada Nystrom, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
